dataList.content:
The Sinners were fatigued and damaged, some already dead.
罪人们精疲力竭、遍体鳞伤，有几人甚至已经没有了气息。
dataList.place:
Unending Hill of Corpses
无边无际的尸山

dataList.content:
As opposed to us, Kromer still stands triumphantly. She reaches for the inside of Sinclair’s coat in what seems like a declaration of his fate.
但是克罗默依旧得意洋洋，伸出手在辛克莱的外套口袋中摸索着，仿佛在宣布死刑一般。

dataList.title:
Nagel und Hammer
钉与锤
dataList.content:
Now then, it’s time, Sinclair.
来吧，时机已到。辛克莱。

dataList.title:
Nagel und Hammer
钉与锤
dataList.content:
I’ll be taking the second coin… your last chance.
第二枚硬币……这最后的机会我就收回了。

Why are you… doing this to me…
为什么……你要对我做这种事……

Why… me…
为什么……偏偏是我……

dataList.title:
Nagel und Hammer
钉与锤
dataList.content:
Sinclair, do you wanna know why I gave you back the basement key when you asked?
辛克莱，知道为什么我老实地将地下室的钥匙还给你了吗？

dataList.title:
Nagel und Hammer
钉与锤
dataList.content:
Listen close. It’s not because I’d made my discovery or baked a copy of it.
那个啊。既不是因为我已经找到了这里，也不是因为我复制了钥匙。

dataList.title:
Nagel und Hammer
钉与锤
dataList.content:
It’s because you were my key.
而因为你就是我的钥匙啊。

dataList.title:
Nagel und Hammer
钉与锤
dataList.content:
You see, I happen to know of a way to take a peek at the futures that might come true.
我啊，可是知道某种能够窥视无穷可能的未来的方法。

dataList.title:
Nagel und Hammer
钉与锤
dataList.content:
I saw one among them where you and I travel from Nest to Nest, slaughtering heretics together all around the City.
在这之中，我看到了你与我一同穿行于各个巢中，将分散各处的异端全部一扫而空的未来。

dataList.title:
Nagel und Hammer
钉与锤
dataList.content:
Even though you were raised by heretics bearing revolting metal bodies…
尽管你成长在令人作呕的异端之躯的膝下……

dataList.title:
Nagel und Hammer
钉与锤
dataList.content:
Part of you still felt disgusted by them. Funny, isn’t it?
但是你依然觉得他们恶心。不是很有意思吗？

dataList.title:
Nagel und Hammer
钉与锤
dataList.content:
You would stab them in the head with your halberd!
你用那长柄斧贯穿了异端者的头颅！

D-Don’t you lie to me…
别、别说谎了……

dataList.title:
Nagel und Hammer
钉与锤
dataList.content:
While I smash their heads with a hammer!
而我则愉悦地用锤子砸碎他们的脑袋！

Stop it…!
闭嘴……！

dataList.title:
Nagel und Hammer
钉与锤
dataList.content:
Ahaha… In that world, you looked like the freest person in the universe, transcending everything.
啊哈哈……我所见的那个世界里的你，真的是世上最为自由而超然之人。

No…
不对……

You’re lying!!!
你说谎！！！

dataList.title:
Nagel und Hammer
钉与锤
dataList.content:
Whether I’m lying or not…
无论是不是谎言……

dataList.title:
Nagel und Hammer
钉与锤
dataList.content:
Ufu.
唔呼。

Kromer suddenly cracked a wry laugh and stopped moving.
就在那时，克罗默发出了怪异的笑声，同时停止了动作。

<The Golden Bough…!>
<金枝……！>

The Golden Bough on the altar resonated with her cackle, and began to glow brighter.
放置在祭坛上的金枝似乎与她的笑声共鸣了一般，光芒开始逐渐变强。

Then…
随后……

dataList.title:
Nagel und Hammer
钉与锤
dataList.content:
Aah…! It’s begun… At last, my final grudge will be fulfilled!
啊啊……！开始了……！终于，我最后的愿望得以实现的时刻到来了！

A mass of flesh engulfs her lower half.
肉块将她的下半身包裹了起来。

From the hideous organic growth, bundles of ambiguous appendages stretch outward in countless numbers.
无数恐怖而恶心的肉块，以及难以分辨是胳膊还是腿部的肢体不断增生出来。

As if desire and madness were made manifest…
宛如欲望与疯狂的集合体一般……

dataList.title:
Nagel und Hammer
钉与锤
dataList.content:
Come… Sinclair.
来吧……辛克莱。

dataList.title:
Nagel und Hammer
钉与锤
dataList.content:
Rip me up and chew me down.
试着来杀了我吧。

dataList.title:
Nagel und Hammer
钉与锤
dataList.content:
If you can, that is… Keheh.
如果你能做到的话……呵呵。
